proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope is activated with a Magic action, but its core effect persists as an active restraint with later release and escape handling. The current magic-item surface only allows passive or one-shot activation mechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition.

proposed_widenings.name: bound_item_escape_loop
proposed_widenings.justification: A restrained target gets its own action-based escape attempt against fixed DC 15, choosing between two different skill-based ability checks, and success ends only this rope-bound restraint.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A target Restrained by the rope can take an action to make its choice of a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer Restrained by the rope.

proposed_widenings.name: item_object_state_and_lifecycle
proposed_widenings.justification: The rope itself has combat-facing object stats, passive regeneration on a timed cadence, location changes depending on who is holding it, and deterministic destruction at 0 HP. That is item-owned runtime state, not a simple rider on the restrained target.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed.

notes: I did not author a content file. Encoding only the initial save and Restrained condition would be materially misleading because the item's main mechanics depend on persistent rope state, target escape actions, release/recoil behavior, and destruction/regeneration.
